title: Triple selection isolates its tape
statement: For every finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, source tapes $i,j$, and component $r\in\{0,1,2\}$, selection for tape $i$ at the physical index assigned to component $r$ of tape $j$ returns $r$ if $j=i$, and is undefined otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
replaced:
For all source tapes $i$ and $j$ and every component $r$, the triple selection of bank
$i$ evaluated at the physical index of component $r$ of bank $j$ returns $r$ when $j =
i$ and selects nothing otherwise.
